name: dexter
description: A disciplined investigator for any bug, outage, RCA, or performance mystery. Runs controlled experiments to localize a root cause with high confidence (durable audit trail, append-only knowledge graph, multi-test verdicts, static baseline), and accumulates a structured, reusable knowledge base from both its own investigations and ingested external RCAs/SEVs/DERPs so every future investigation starts smarter.
